text:
maria: quick question — should saved filters keep the model pin they were created with, or always be model-agnostic?
raj: leaning toward pin provenance. otherwise users open a saved view and see different perf/cost than expected.
jordan: +1 for provenance, but we need a clear UX hint (badge or tooltip) when the pinned model differs from current route default.
maria: agreed. concerns: saved-query proliferation (same filter + many pinned models) and quota implications.
sam: quota problem is real — if a saved view replays against an expensive model unexpectedly, customers incur surprises. we should surface estimated cost delta in preview.
maria: good call. rough idea: when saving allow "inherit model" vs "freeze model" option. default to inherit but warn when switching target model later.
raj: implementation concerns for backend: saved_query needs a new field `model_pin` and `model_pin_provenance` (enum: frozen|inherited|unset). plus change in eval/preview API to accept override and return cost_estimate.
jordan: proposal for API payload preview:
```
POST /api/console/saved_queries/preview
{
  "saved_query_id": "sq_123",
  "override_model": "redwood-3b-q4",
  "sample_rate": 0.02
}
```
response should include `tokens_estimate`, `latency_p95_est`, `cost_delta` and `telemetry_sampled_count`.
raj: telemetry_sampled_count needs to reflect sampling rules — if preview hits 0 because of sampling, UI should say "preview not available under current sampling" not silently show stale metrics.
maria: UX flow: save modal with two checkboxes: "Freeze model (keep exact model at save time)" and "Include cost warning in share link". default: freeze unchecked, warning checked.
sam: can we also have a server-side backfill that updates provenance when model is renamed/retired? e.g., if `redwood-3b-2024-07` is replaced, we should map old to new variant or mark as orphan.
jordan: mapping table fine, but orphaned pins should surface in Console with a CTA to migrate. avoid auto-mapping without user opt-in.
raj: ops/billing note: when someone opens a saved view that triggers a quota check, route-level quota enforcement should evaluate against the effective model (post-provenance resolution). Need a small contract change in quota service to accept `model` param.
maria: agree. who wants to own the API contract change?
raj: platform team can own server changes, but product needs to own the UX bits and the migration policy.
sam: FYI infra-bot: staging rollout for saved-query-provenance landed at 1725004500
infra-bot: deploy — saved-query-provenance v1 deployed to staging (hash: a1b2c3) :rocket:
maria: okay next steps: (1) raj to draft API contract PR for preview + quota param, (2) jordan to mock modal + badge comps, (3) sam to write migration playbook for orphaned pins. aim for RFC by EOW.
raj: I'll open PR and add schema change notes for `model_pin_provenance`.
jordan: I'll drop initial Figma link later today.
sam: I'll sketch migration steps and edgecases (deprecated models, renamed aliases, private variants).
maria: sweet. tagging @product-ship for awareness. thanks all!
